Group rides in Florida

23 recurring group rides around Florida: 12 road, 11 social, 2 cruiser. 6 roll on weeknights, 10 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Caloosa Riders Sunday Welcome Ride in Fort Myers — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Naples Velo Saturday Ft. Myers Bridge Ride runs black group 30+ mph in places; Blue group 24–27 mph; rotating paceline.
